description: This file configures Vitest testing environment for the Mattermost extension within a larger project. It imports functions and constants, defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables, creates a Vitest configuration specific to the Mattermost extension, and exports a default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for Vitest from environment variables, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig( createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the Mattermost extension, merging environment-specified include patterns with default test roots.
